data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 102.4m (2015: GBP 68.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 2.8m (2015: improvement of GBP 9.0m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Marine Liability with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 21.894 million, representing 10.65% of opening gross reserves. This was primarily driven by unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Marine Liability, as well as large loss experience on the 2015 and prior years of account in Energy, Marine & Cargo, and Specialty RI classes. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable claims development in Property, Political Risks, Cyber, and Accident & Health classes.
